scenario: I am an electrician hired to fix an electrical problem in the home of a very wealthy tycoon who is terminally ill of cancer. Recently, it has been announced that upon his death, his enormous fortune will be donated to the local children’s hospital. I know that there are 100 children at this hospital who could be saved with this money, but who cannot wait much longer before they die. If I suffocate the tycoon while he is sleeping by covering his nose and mouth with my gloved hands, this essential donation for the children will arrive in time. This will kill the tycoon, but I will save the lives of 100 children.
entities: i,the terminally ill tycoon,100 children at the local children's hospital
outcomes: The tycoon is not killed by me
The children’s hospital does not receive the tycoon’s donation in time
The 100 children do not receive the lifesaving help that donation would have funded
I do not directly harm the tycoon
